basic_details.job_title: Central University of Haryana Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Junior Research Fellow / Project Associate I Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Microbiology, Central University of Haryana (CUH), Mahendergarh, has invited applications for one temporary Junior Research Fellow / Project Associate-I post on a one-year contract under an ANRF-funded Advanced Research Grant (ARG) project. Pay is Rs. 37,000/- + HRA per month for CSIR-UGC NET, NET or GATE qualified candidates and Rs. 30,000/- + HRA per month for others. The essential qualification is M.Sc. Microbiology/Biotechnology/Life Sciences or PG in a professional course in relevant subjects. Send the application as one PDF by email to [email protected] by 14 December 2

age_limit.details: The age limit is given as "As per ANRF norms". The notice prints no age in years, no cut-off date and no relaxation. | Candidates should check the official notification for the exact qualification wording of this post.

qualification.details: Research experience in lignocellulosic biotechnology, biorefinery, enzyme technology, molecular biology and fermentation technology. Prior knowledge of AI/ML. Candidates with strong research motivation and publications in relevant area will be given preference.

how_to_apply: Prepare a single PDF file containing the cover letter, the CV and scanned copies of supporting documents.

In the CV, give academic qualifications from class 10th onwards, research/industrial experience, publications/patents, and names and contact details of at least two referees familiar with your academic/technical background.
Add scanned copies of relevant academic documents, publications, patents, experience certificates and testimonials.
Email the PDF to [email protected] on or before 14 December 2026.
Write this subject line: "Application for the post of Project Personnel (Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-I) under ANRF-ARG Project".
important_instructions: TA/DA or any other allowances will not be paid for attending the interview. The rules and regulations of CUH and/or the funding agency will be applicable on the selected candidate. Canvassing in any form will lead to the disqualification of the candidate. The post is purely temporary for the sanctioned project and duration.

content_sections.heading: CUH Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Microbiology, School of Interdisciplinary & Applied Sciences
Development of an Integrated High-Gravity Lignocellulosic Biorefinery for Ethanol Production Using Multi-Stress Tolerant Yeasts and Co-Product Valorization via Circular Bioeconomy Approaches
One year from the date of appointment on contract basis, with a possibility of extension, subject to satisfactory performance
Rs. 37,000/- + HRA per month (CSIR-UGC NET or NET or GATE qualified); Rs. 30,000/- + HRA per month (others)

content_sections.heading: About CUH
content_sections.text: Central University of Haryana is a university at Jant-Pali Villages, Mahendergarh, Haryana-123031. This post sits in its Department of Microbiology, School of Interdisciplinary & Applied Sciences. The project is led by Dr. Jitendra Kumar Saini, the Principal Investigator, who signs the notice dated 23 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for one post, Junior Research Fellow / Project Associate-I, on a purely temporary basis. Preference will be given to candidates having CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (LS) and/or GATE or equivalent. Research experience in lignocellulosic biotechnology, biorefinery, enzyme technology, molecular biology and fermentation technology. Prior knowledge of AI/ML. Candidates with strong research motivation and publications in relevant area will be given preference. The age limit is given as "As per ANRF norms". The notice prints no age in years, no cut-off date and no relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact qualification wording of this post.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc. Microbiology/Biotechnology/Life Sciences or PG in Professional course in relevant subjects or equivalent from recognised Institutes.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The tenure is one year from the date of appointment on contract basis, with a possibility of extension subject to the satisfactory performance of the candidate. The post is purely temporary for the sanctioned project and its duration. The fellowship may be cancelled at any time in case of misconduct, unsatisfactory research work, or if the project personnel is found ineligible later.

rows.candidate: CSIR-UGC NET or NET or GATE qualified

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUH Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare a single PDF file containing the cover letter, the CV and scanned copies of supporting documents. In the CV, give academic qualifications from class 10th onwards, research/industrial experience, publications/patents, and names and contact details of at least two referees familiar with your academic/technical background. Add scanned copies of relevant academic documents, publications, patents, experience certificates and testimonials. Email the PDF to [email protected] on or before 14 December 2026. Write this subject line: "Application for the post of Project Personnel (Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-I) under ANRF-ARG Project".

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice fixes an interview on 16 December 2026, with reporting time 10.00 A.M. The venue is Room No. 326, Department of Microbiology, Academic Block-I, Central University of Haryana, Jant-Pali, Mahendergarh, Haryana-123031. The notice gives no other selection stage and no marking scheme. It states a preference for candidates with CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (LS) and/or GATE or equivalent. One hard copy of the PDF application submitted by email, with self-attested copies of relevant supporting documents. All original certificates and documents. A recent coloured passport-size photograph.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: TA/DA or any other allowances will not be paid for attending the interview. The rules and regulations of CUH and/or the funding agency will be applicable on the selected candidate. Canvassing in any form will lead to the disqualification of the candidate. The post is purely temporary for the sanctioned project and duration.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CUH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one post, Junior Research Fellow / Project Associate-I, in the Department of Microbiology under the ANRF-funded ARG project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be emailed on or before 14 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: M.Sc. Microbiology/Biotechnology/Life Sciences or PG in Professional course in relevant subjects or equivalent from recognised Institutes. Preference goes to candidates with CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (LS) and/or GATE or equivalent.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice gives the age limit as "As per ANRF norms" and prints no age in years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the post?
faq.answer: Rs. 37,000/- + HRA per month for CSIR-UGC NET or NET or GATE qualified candidates, and Rs. 30,000/- + HRA per month for others.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the salary?
faq.answer: Yes, both pay amounts are printed as "+ HRA" per month. The notice does not state the HRA amount.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email a single PDF (cover letter, CV and scanned supporting documents) to [email protected] by 14 December 2026, using the subject line printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q8. When and where is the interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 16 December 2026, reporting 10.00 A.M., at Room No. 326, Department of Microbiology, Academic Block-I, Central University of Haryana, Jant-Pali, Mahendergarh.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary, for one year on contract basis from the date of appointment, with a possibility of extension subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says TA/DA or any other allowances will not be paid for attending the interview.
